title: SoftBody3D breaks when Mesh has BlendShape
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.arch_linux - https://godotengine.org OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 580.105.08 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti

### Issue description

When using a Mesh with BlendShape for the SoftBody3D, the mesh just disappeared and the engine throws these errors:
```
ERROR: Condition "p_blend_shapes.size() != blend_shapes.size()" is true.
   at: add_surface_from_arrays (scene/resources/mesh.cpp:1819)
ERROR: Index p_idx = 0 is out of bounds (surfaces.size() = 0).
   at: surface_set_material (scene/resources/mesh.cpp:1946)
ERROR: Index p_surface = 0 is out of bounds (surface_override_materials.size() = 0).
   at: set_surface_override_material (scene/3d/mesh_instance_3d.cpp:360)
ERROR: Index (uint32_t)p_surface = 0 is out of bounds (mesh->surface_count = 0).
   at: mesh_get_surface (drivers/gles3/storage/mesh_storage.cpp:617)
ERROR: Soft body's mesh needs to have indices
   at: set_mesh (modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_soft_body_3d.cpp:148)
ERROR: Index (uint32_t)p_surface = 0 is out of bounds (mesh->surface_count = 0).
   at: mesh_get_surface (drivers/gles3/storage/mesh_storage.cpp:617)
ERROR: Condition "p_data.is_empty()" is true.
   at: mesh_surface_update_vertex_region (drivers/gles3/storage/mesh_storage.cpp:537)
ERROR: Condition "p_data.is_empty()" is true.
   at: mesh_surface_update_vertex_region (drivers/gles3/storage/mesh_storage.cpp:537)
............
```
Jolt Physics SoftBody3D also breaks.

### Steps to reproduce

Set SoftBody3D Mesh to one with a blendshape and run.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[soft-body-3d-blend-shape-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23832969/soft-body-3d-blend-shape-issue.zip)
